# Kraviona

> AI-First Technology & Digital Solutions Company. "Intelligence Meets Innovation."

Kraviona is an AI-first technology company engineering custom software, autonomous AI agents, SaaS products, e-commerce systems, and performance marketing architectures for ambitious businesses worldwide.

- Website: https://www.kraviona.com
- Contact: contact@kraviona.com | +91 96085 53167
- Location: East Delhi, Delhi 110092, India
- Founder & Lead Engineer: Amar Kumar (https://www.kraviona.com/authors/amar-kumar)

## Technical Architecture & Standards
- Primary Stack: Next.js (App Router, Server Components), React, Node.js, Express, Python (FastAPI), MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pinecone.
- SEO & AEO: Strict Schema.org linked graph, semantic HTML5, Core Web Vitals < 1.8s LCP, direct answer formatting for Perplexity and ChatGPT Search.
